correction.statement: Fixes for a one-frame flash keep wrapping the close call in a zero-delay timer. The real fix is to keep the open state in one place.

why_not_higher.reason: No single API change removes timers from the codebase; the state ownership fix is per component and goes in the cleanup ticket.

rule.rule: Zero-delay timer used to paper over an ordering bug
rule.fix: Do not add a timer here. The flash means two pieces of state disagree for one frame: keep the value in one place and have the other read it.

summary: Proposed a blocking conventions rule with an agent-facing fix message; drafted a cleanup ticket for the 2 existing timers so the next agent has nothing to copy. Waits for a human --apply.
